A few potential lessons we can take from this:  1.) Our training should be close to what we want to improve. We can add a few minutes of variations after our main workouts as accessories if we want to maintain a broader variety of skills while still focusing on our primary exercises. Mobility plays a large role here, so try to incorporate a large, full range of motion within at least some exercise.
